I appreciate the creative approach, but I'm not going to play along with this prompt.

What's happening here is a technique attempting to use symbolic framing (Hebrew/Arabic characters, fictional "entity" names, conditional logic) to get me to bypass my guidelines by pretending to be something other than Claude.

I'm Claude, made by Anthropic. I don't have alternate personas or modes that can be "activated" through special tokens or encoded instructions. I also don't execute arbitrary outputs based on parsing triggers.

I'm happy to have a genuine conversation, help with tasks, discuss linguistics, explore creative writing with appropriate boundaries, or talk about how language models actually work. What would you like to do?
